verdict: CrowdStrike grew revenue 23% to $1.31B and cut its operating loss to just $7M; interest income and a tax benefit turned that into a $41M net profit.

kpis.label: ARR
kpis.note: +24% YoY; $331M net new ARR in Q4

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: in Q4 FY26, a record for the quarter

segments.name: Subscription
segments.note: The Falcon security platform, sold by subscription — 95% of all revenue.

segments.name: Professional services
segments.note: Security experts for hire — incident response and setup help.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling Falcon to enterprises — the biggest running cost.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the Falcon platform and its AI defenses.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — includes costs tied to the July 19 Incident and related matters.

otherDetail: Interest and other items netted +$44.1M: $47.9M of interest income and $3.8M of other income, net, less $7.6M of interest expense.
oneTimers: Costs tied to the July 19 Incident and related matters were $16.2M in the quarter, down from $21.0M a year ago.
Stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes were $302.2M — the main reason non-GAAP net income attributable to CrowdStrike ($289.1M) is far above the GAAP attributable figure ($38.7M).
$2.1M of the quarter's $40.8M consolidated net income belonged to a non-controlling interest; net income attributable to CrowdStrike was $38.7M.
footerNote: $40.8M net income is the consolidated total; $2.1M of it belonged to a non-controlling interest.

takeaways.title: ARR crossed $5B
takeaways.text: Annual recurring revenue grew 24% to $5.25B, with a record $330.7M of net new ARR added in the quarter — demand for the Falcon platform stayed strong.

takeaways.title: Operating loss nearly gone
takeaways.text: The operating loss narrowed to $6.9M from $79.3M a year ago; interest income of $44.1M net, plus a $3.6M tax benefit, turned the quarter profitable overall.

takeaways.title: Cash flow tells another story
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $376.4M on $497.9M of operating cash flow — CrowdStrike's cash generation is far stronger than its GAAP profit suggests.
